verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents a public REST API with bearer-token authentication. It covers creating and listing candidates, creating offers, adding profile fields, listing departments and locations, and a separate Careers Site API, plus webhooks with test and request logs. The docs are agent-friendly: probes confirmed a live llms.txt and markdown versions of pages. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and no evidence on rate limits or pagination.
